name: Participatory Interpretation Registry
purpose: Formalize interpretation as embedded participatory reconstruction rather than detached symbolic assignment.

interpretation_classes.definition: Interpretation strictly bounded by the observer's local neighborhood and available trace metadata.
Interpretation that requires active multi-aspect trace alignment to maintain stability.
Interpretations that are structurally constrained by irreducible projection conflicts.
Interpretation subject to dynamic feedback loops from previous participatory reconstructions.
Interpretation approaching the boundary of recoverability horizons.

governance_rules.rule: Every interpretation must identify its participatory dependence and embedded limits.
Claims of 'objective interpretation' trigger immediate REJECT_ESCALATION.

forbidden_claims: Participatory interpretation proves the full source relation.
Meaning assignment can be completely detached from projection history.
Interpretive stability derives physical consciousness laws.
